_provenance: Manifest of curriculum source documents, each mapped to the AAMC content category it covers and the topic:: tag its generated cards carry. All source documents are original content written for this project - see each file's own provenance note. This manifest is what speedrun/tools/ai-cardgen/generate_coverage_cards.py iterates over, and what makes the coverage map's denominator meaningful: adding a category here means writing real source material for it, not relabelling existing cards.
_why_separate_from_generate_py: generate.py remains pointed at source_material.md alone and is deliberately untouched. Its output feeds the gold-set eval (98% vs 0%) and the leakage check, both already run and reported in speedrun/docs/ai-subsystem.md; regenerating it would invalidate those numbers for no benefit.
